declarations.name: consecutive_factorization_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem consecutive_factorization_iff (n m : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    n.factorial + 1 = m ^ 2 ↔
      ∃ a b : ℕ, b = a + 1 ∧ a.Coprime b ∧
        4 * a * b = n.factorial ∧ m = a + b

declarations.name: prime_successor_square_divides
declarations.statement:
theorem prime_successor_square_divides (n m : ℕ)
    (hp : (n + 1).Prime) (hsol : n.factorial + 1 = m ^ 2) :
    (n + 1) ^ 2 ∣ n.factorial + 1

declarations.name: prime_successor_obstruction
declarations.statement:
theorem prime_successor_obstruction (n : ℕ) (hp : (n + 1).Prime)
    (hnot : ¬ (n + 1) ^ 2 ∣ n.factorial + 1) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, n.factorial + 1 ≠ m ^ 2

declarations.name: fixed_modulus_eventually_one
declarations.statement:
theorem fixed_modulus_eventually_one (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hn : q ≤ n) :
    (n.factorial + 1) % q = 1 % q
